personality_one_liner: A bouncy, tactile, and instantly readable casual mobile game that feels juicy and highly responsive.

spacing.rule: Generous tactile spacing. Elements should feel like physical objects separated by clear air. Use xl and 2xl for major layout blocks.

do's: Use solid, opaque surfaces to maintain the tactile/playful mood.
Keep overlays solid with a semi-transparent dark backdrop instead of blur.
dont's: Avoid heavy glass or blur, which clashes with the grounded, chunky, and tactile 2D nature of the game UI.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Entry point: Start the game, view best score, and access quick settings.
screens.layout: Center-aligned vertical stack. Top: Game Title ('Color Tap Challenge' using large Fredoka font in brand color). Middle: Oversized PLAY button (pill-shaped, brandPrimary background) and Best Score chip below it. Bottom right (or lower middle): Settings icon (Sound/Vibration toggles). Background can use a very subtle pattern or flat surface color.

screens.name: Gameplay
screens.purpose: Core loop: Display instruction, show targets, process reaction taps, update HUD.
screens.layout: Vertical-first thumb-friendly layout. Top Area (HUD): Row containing Level badge, Score, and 3 Heart icons for lives. Below HUD: A horizontal decreasing timer bar. Center Area: Large instruction text (e.g., 'TAP RED'). Bottom Area: A 2x2 grid of oversized circular or pill-shaped color targets. Use `targetRed`, `targetGreen`, `targetYellow`, and `targetBlack` for the targets. Keep the targets in the lower half of the screen for easy thumb access.

screens.name: GameOver
screens.purpose: Show results when lives reach 0 and allow restarting.
screens.layout: Overlay or distinct screen. Top: 'GAME OVER' title and a 3D minimal trophy image. Middle: Final Score (large) and Best Score (secondary). Bottom: 'PLAY AGAIN' CTA button pinned above the safe area.

game_over_trophy.alt: Minimal gold and silver medals on white podiums

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the 'Tactile / Playful' personality. Do not use any blue, purple, or indigo shades anywhere (strictly banned). Use the predefined target colors (Red, Green, Yellow, Black).
Typography MUST cap at 500 weight. Use size (e.g., 3xl) to create hierarchy for HUD and instructions, never bold weights.

Implement the Stroop effect logic for later levels: The instruction text might say 'GREEN' but the text color is rendered in `targetRed`. The user must tap the color corresponding to the WORD ('GREEN'), not the ink.
Interaction Feedback: Every tap on a color target MUST include haptic feedback (impactLight for correct, notificationError for wrong) and an animated press scale (0.93 with an overshoot spring).
On correct tap: Increase score, subtly flash the target, reset timer.
On wrong tap: Shake the screen slightly (using react-native-reanimated), flash the target error color, remove one life.
Level Transitions: Show a large 'LEVEL X' overlay that fades in, slightly scales up, and fades out quickly over the Gameplay screen without a hard navigation transition.
Timer Bar: Use a smooth reanimated width transition for the countdown timer. If timer hits zero, it counts as a wrong tap.
Ensure large touch targets (minimum 64x64 for color targets, ideally larger filling the 2x2 grid).
Persist the 'Best Score' and user settings (Sound/Vibration) locally using AsyncStorage.
